title: plugin-security: a sys_user_position row whose user_id is not a member of the row's organization is accepted, so a platform admin can stage a dormant cross-organization position grant
body:
Filing gate: ① a product defect, reach measured. It also executes a maintainer ruling: objectstack-ai/cloud#1765, ruling `6053780796`, letter **A**, with the maintainer's word 「22147  1765 22167 同意」 (2026-10-08T06:23Z, director batch #290 item 4). That ruling names this repo's `plugin-security` as the landing site. Reader: triage routes it; by its package it lands in the `plugin-security` lane.

Filed by the `repo:cloud` seat (`repo:cloud#1`, R45, session `session_011jobP72PwN3whNm55GetXQ`) as the ruling's 裁后执行 asks. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured (objectstack-ai/cloud#1765, os-dev-report `6052857210`; cloud `6532ae1`, framework pin `56bf27af`, posture `isolated`)

- **The write lands.** The platform admin used Setup → Positions → Holders → Assign user to pick a user who belongs only to org northwind, onto a Default Organization position. `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position` answered **201**. The row reads back with `organization_id` = Default Organization, and the user's only `sys_member` row is northwind.
- **A dormant grant.** The row does nothing in the user's own organization. Once the user was invited into Default Organization, accepted and switched to it, their session carried `sales_manager` with no further grant.
- **What holds:**
  - An explicit foreign `organization_id` stamp is refused 403 by the organization wall.
  - A nonexistent `user_id` is refused 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` / `reference_not_found`.
  - That `user_id` check is **existence only**. Nothing checks the user's membership in the row's organization.
- **Reach:** the platform admin, the only principal measured able to write the table. A tenant owner is refused 403 even for a same-organization write (cloud#1628).

## The ruling (A), to implement

- **Refuse at write.** A non-system insert or update of `sys_user_position` whose `user_id` has no `sys_member` row in the row's `organization_id` is refused, for every caller, platform admin included. The refusal lives in `packages/plugins/plugin-security`, beside `position-catalog-refusal.ts`.
- **Envelope:** the row's existing 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` with `fields[].code: reference_not_found`. No new error code.
- **System writes stand down,** as the sibling refusal does.
- **"Assign first, invite later" is not a supported order.** No producer or reader of it was found.
- ⛔ **Not taken:**
  - B, narrowing the picker (`sys-position.page.ts` `add.picker`), because it leaves the HTTP door open. It may follow later as UX, on objectstack-ai/objectui#11903.
  - C, accepting the row and documenting it.
- **Not RLS.** `admin_full_access` having no RLS is by design (cloud#1628). This is a referential rule on the row, so it does not reopen that.

## Tests

- A platform admin's insert of a non-member is refused with the envelope (asserting `status`, `code` and `fields[0].code`), and the row is absent.
- **Positive control:** the same insert of a member succeeds.
- An update that moves `user_id` to a non-member is refused.
- A system write is not refused.

## Not measured (noted by the dev)

The sibling junction `sys_user_permission_set` (`user_id` × `organization_id`) probably has the same user-axis gap. Measure it in this card and fold it in, or record why not.

## Done when

The refusal is pinned on both sides. Cloud receives it with v18 (cloud consumes this repo by pin; objectstack#22050 ruling B), and objectstack-ai/cloud#1765 is `Blocked-by` this card.

## Dedupe

A semantic search for `sys_user_position user_id not member of organization cross-org position assignment refusal` finds 12 adjacent hits (#19860, #19819, #20297, #17247 and others, all closed, plus the open epic #15194). None covers the user-axis membership of the row.
